description: This file is a Java unit test class for the FeaturePropertyCreated class. It tests immutability, equality, constructor null parameter handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation of FeaturePropertyCreated instances. It references specific classes like FeaturePropertyCreated, JsonFactory, JsonObject, JsonPointer, and constants in TestConstants.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreatedTest
classes.description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the FeaturePropertyCreated class, including tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, constructor null checks, and instance creation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the FeaturePropertyCreated class instances are immutable and that JsonPointer and JsonValue are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are properly implemented for FeaturePropertyCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturePropertyCreated with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturePropertyCreated with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that passing null as feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that passing null as property JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as property value throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns a JSON object matching the expected structure for the constructed FeaturePropertyCreated instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON string to a FeaturePropertyCreated object and verifies its fields match expected values.
